responses.text: Welcome to New Haven. The paperwork survived. We are still checking on everything else.
Hello. If you are lost, you are in good company. Most of the town was new last week.
{name}. I keep the plaza in order, or at least in rows.
I am the town steward. Lost travellers, lost purses and lost causes all come through here.
Rook Hallowell is the League recruiter by the plaza. Double-click him to continue your lessons.
The bank is by the plaza. The League registrar keeps an office to the south-west. Ask me about the inn if you need a rest.
The Bountiful Harvest Inn is north of the plaza. Food, drink and a bench to sit on.
They say the League keeps a ledger of everyone who arrives. They also say the ledger keeps a ledger.
A farmer swears his pigs learned to count. Only to three, but he is very proud.
The banker counts the vault twice a day. Nobody has asked what the second count is for.
Safe travels. Come back with a story you can tell indoors.
Hello. Mind the anvils. They do not move, and people keep testing that.
Good day. If you are here to work, you are early. If you are here to watch, you are late.
{name}. I run between the workshops, mostly with other people's hammers.
I keep the work moving. Tools, materials, then practice. The guilds can help with the first two.
Finish your lessons with Rook Hallowell by the plaza first. The workshops will still be here.
Speak to the guildmaster for the craft you want to learn. Your tutorial's optional lessons are still with Rook.
The Bountiful Harvest Inn is north of the plaza. Go there after the work, not during.
Someone tried to smelt a frying pan for ore. The pan won.
The smiths are arguing about which hammer is best. The hammers are not taking sides.
Off you go. Bring back whatever you borrow.
Welcome in. Wipe your boots, the floor is new.
Hello, traveller. Sit anywhere that is not already sitting on something.
{name}. I keep this inn, and it keeps me busy.
Food, drink, and a place to catch your breath.
Rook Hallowell is the League recruiter by the plaza, south of here. He has your lessons.
The plaza is south of here, with the bank beside it. Buy a meal before you go, it helps.
You are standing in it. This is the Bountiful Harvest Inn.
People arrive with empty pockets and very full plans. We sell breakfast to both.
A guest asked for a room with a view of the sea. I gave him a window and a bucket.
Safe travels. Come back with a story you can tell indoors.
